name: Wisconsin Wetland Conservation Trust: Restore (wetland restoration grants)

funder.name: Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources (Wisconsin Wetland Conservation Trust)

summary: In-lieu-fee funding for wetland restoration projects on permanent mitigation sites in Wisconsin, with quarterly proposal windows. Nonprofit conservation organisations can apply, and a separate strand covers nonprofit projects on DNR-owned or eased lands.
